svg.title: Process routing spindle shaft (example)
svg.text: Process routing – spindle shaft SPS (14 operations, lot 10, twin times and example rates)
Box = operation · machine · time per shaft · cost per shaft · blue line = quality gate (stop the flow if not ok) · dashed box = can be bought as a service
Soft machining (Op 10–80): turning, drilling, milling, pre-grinding – every Ø keeps stock
Hard machining (Op 100–130): everything relative to the ground seats A-B
Time per shaft (min) – furnace times are the furnace hours shared by 12 shafts
Total ≈ 662 min (11 h) · cost ≈ $1 118 per shaft incl. material $230 (51.1 kg bar)
Values = twin example values · not to scale · 2026-11
